name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-dalux
title: Dalux
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Dalux Build API (Field and Box).

environmentVariables.name: DALUX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key of the Dalux API identity (company settings, API identities).

environmentVariables.name: DALUX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Customer-specific API base URL shown next to the API identity in Dalux.

environmentVariables.name: DALUX_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Enable the write tools (upload_file, change_company, change_project).

environmentVariables.name: DALUX_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project ids this instance may access.

environmentVariables.name: DALUX_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
